method: Built-in image_gen; selected clean outputs reconstructed from user-supplied master. Routine size and file-format conversion uses macOS sips/iconutil.

assets.name: app-icon-dark
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: production macOS app icon. Input image is the EDIT TARGET, a master branding presentation sheet. Extract/reconstruct ONLY the large dark rounded-square app icon in the middle-left of the supplied sheet, labelled App Icon (512×512), as ONE clean individual 1024×1024 image. Remove the size label and every other object. Preserve the exact open-book silhouette, layered pages, white terminal >_ symbol, icy white-to-cyan-to-electric-blue gradient, dark navy rounded-square tile, subtle cyan rim, and proportions. Crisp high-quality edges, front-facing flat icon, no perspective. Center the rounded-square tile occupying 90% of square canvas with a transparent outer margin. Preserve the design, no invented decorations, no text, no watermark.

assets.name: social-preview
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: GitHub repository social preview and hideouts.io project hero. The supplied master is the EDIT TARGET. Reconstruct just the BOTTOM blue mountain/forest banner as one polished standalone 1280×640 landscape 2:1 image, adapting spacing to this true aspect ratio. Preserve the source's dark midnight navy, cyan/electric blue palette, open-book >_ logo, crisp bold ManPagesCatalog title (ManPages white, Catalog blue), stylized mountains, silhouetted pine trees, and small terminal-style panel at right. All vital text/logo within 60px safe edges. Exact title "ManPagesCatalog". Exact tagline "EXPLORE · SEARCH · LEARN · REFERENCE". Replace the original Linux/Unix marketing sentence with accurate app copy: "Your Mac’s manuals, within reach." and underneath "Search commands. Read documentation. Export PDFs.". Right panel should be a tasteful illustration, not claimed screenshot: top "$ man _" and exactly four clean rows "Search manuals", "Read documentation", "Find in page", "Export PDF", with simple matching icons. No categories, no extra feature promises. No label saying GitHub Social Preview, no dimension labels, no sheet remnants. Sharp professional typography.
